 Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. Job Title:

Network Engineer (Office Connect) - GCS

Job Summary:

The Network Engineer (Office Connect) within Global Connectivity Solutions (GCS) supports vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, firmware upgrades, and production deployments across enterprise campus network environments. The role executes technical activities involving Cisco Catalyst switching, Cisco wireless infrastructure, Meraki switching, Meraki wireless, and associated network management platforms.

The position works with Senior Engineers, Network Engineering, Network Operations, Information Security, Workplace Technology, Change Management, Outage Management, local office teams, and vendors to deliver upgrades safely, troubleshoot implementation issues, and maintain compliance with approved software and operational standards.

Job Description

  • Execute vulnerability remediation, firmware upgrades, and software maintenance across Cisco switching, Cisco wireless, Meraki switching, and Meraki wireless platforms.
  • Perform software image validation, pre-upgrade assessments, compatibility checks, post-upgrade verification, and campus device health checks.
  • Support software lifecycle management and platform currency for Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switches, Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco access points, Meraki MS switches, and Meraki MR access points.
  • Assist with device onboarding, configuration validation, testing, migration, hardware refresh, and deployment activities across office locations.
  • Support Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies including VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel/LACP, HSRP/VRRP, ACLs, DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection, port security, and basic routing.
  • Troubleshoot switching issues involving connectivity, VLAN assignment, interfaces, trunks, spanning tree, port channels, routing adjacencies, authentication, software defects, and firmware upgrades.
  • Support wireless operations including SSID validation, access point onboarding, controller and AP upgrades, RF troubleshooting, coverage verification, roaming analysis, and wireless client connectivity.
  • Apply knowledge of 802.11ac, 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), and Wi-Fi 6E during compatibility validation, implementation, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Use Cisco Catalyst Center, Catalyst Center Assurance, Meraki Dashboard, wireless analytics, monitoring tools, logs, and packet captures for visibility, compliance tracking, and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in testing and validation of integrations with identity, security, endpoint, print, and workplace technology services.
  • Prepare implementation procedures, rollback steps, test plans, validation documents, change tasks, technical runbooks, and implementation records.
  • Participate in CAB preparation and support Senior Engineers during technical change reviews when required.
  • Execute approved changes during maintenance windows and provide timely implementation updates to technical leads and stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot issues arising from firmware upgrades, software changes, hardware replacements, or configuration modifications.
  • Escalate complex issues with accurate diagnostics, logs, packet captures, impact details, and actions completed.
  • Participate in outage calls, incident recovery, technical investigation, root cause analysis, and resolution validation.
  • Support access point refreshes, switch migrations, office network upgrades, remediation waves, and campus modernization initiatives.
  • Maintain network inventory, software versions, vulnerability status, compliance evidence, upgrade history, and deployment outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, compliance validation, inventory improvement, monitoring, and reporting.

Knowledge & Competencies Required:

  • Hands-on knowledge of Cisco Catalyst 9000 Series switching and enterprise Layer 2/Layer 3 campus technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Cisco Catalyst 9800 Wireless Controllers, Cisco access points, wireless operations, and firmware lifecycle activities.
  • Working knowledge of Meraki MS Switching, Meraki MR Wireless, Meraki Dashboard administration, device onboarding, firmware management, wireless health, and client analytics.
  • Understanding of VLANs, trunking, STP/RSTP/MST, EtherChannel/LACP, HSRP/VRRP, ACLs, DHCP Snooping, Dynamic ARP Inspection, port security, and basic routing.
  • Understanding of wireless fundamentals including RF behavior, channel utilization, interference, coverage, capacity, roaming, authentication, and client troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of Wi-Fi standards including 802.11ac, 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), and Wi-Fi 6E.
  • Experience using Cisco Catalyst Center, Catalyst Center Assurance, Meraki Dashboard, monitoring tools, logs, and packet captures.
  • Experience supporting vulnerability remediation, firmware upgrades, configuration changes, hardware refreshes, or campus modernization activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting discipline and ability to collect, interpret, and document technical evidence.
  • Working knowledge of Change, Incident, Problem, Risk, and Release Management practices.
  • Good implementation planning, validation, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Knowledge of network monitoring, observability, analytics, and automation platforms.
  • Basic scripting or automation knowledge using APIs, Python, Ansible, Catalyst Center, or Meraki APIs is desirable.
  • Strong ownership, attention to detail, compliance focus, and continuous improvement mindset.
  • Willingness to work in a global support model, including rotational shifts and support across multiple time zones.
  • Flexibility to support maintenance, deployments, upgrades, remediation, and incident recovery outside regular business hours when required.
  • Ready to travel when required and collaborate with globally distributed teams, vendors, service providers, and stakeholders.

title: Associate Technical Project Manager
jobDescription:
Job Summary

As an Associate Technical Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end delivery of customer projects across cloud migration, modernization, infrastructure, and AI engagements. You will work alongside Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers to translate an approved solution into a planned, tracked, and governed delivery - and you will be the primary point of contact the customer relies on for progress, risks, and decisions.

This role sits at the intersection of technology and delivery governance. You are expected to understand the technical solution well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependencies early, and hold both the team and the customer to agreed scope, effort, and timelines.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning

  • Review project proposals to ensure in-scope and out-of-scope items, effort and cost estimation, deliverables, assumptions, and the proposed architecture are clearly defined.
  • Analyze project requirements and prepare or update project timelines, delivery methodology, RACI, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Ensure use cases and test cases are clearly defined before the project is onboarded to the delivery team.
  • Prepare the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) before implementation and review it with the Technical Lead.
  • Establish timelines and milestones and plan delivery within the approved budget.

Technical Project Management

  • Develop a sound understanding of the technical deliverables and work closely with Architects and Technical Leads to identify and manage risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
  • Regularly review the technical solution and implementation progress with the Technical Lead to ensure planned activities are completed within the agreed timeline.
  • Track project scope, schedule, effort, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and as per agreed scope.
  • Assess project risks, develop risk mitigation strategies, and implement contingency plans to minimize the impact of potential issues.
  • Identify project blockers and follow the defined escalation hierarchy for timely resolution.

Delivery Across Project Types

  • Migration and cloud projects: Manage end-to-end delivery of cloud migration, modernization, and infrastructure projects, tracking cloud-specific activities, technical dependencies, risks, and milestones with Architects and Technical Leads.
  • Non-migration technical projects: Manage end-to-end delivery of AI PoC implementations, AI assessments, and similar engagements, ensuring requirements, use cases, test cases, technical deliverables, and timelines are clearly defined and aligned with the approved solution.
  • Coordinate with the technical teams responsible for moving applications between Development, Test, Integration, and Production environments.
  • Manage change requests across cloud migration activities and track all associated events to maximize system availability and avoid errors.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Coordinate and conduct regular daily stand-ups and customer meetings, and maintain meeting minutes, action items, expectations, and discussion points.
  • Prepare and share weekly project status reports covering progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and next steps.
  • Maintain effective communication and coordination between customers, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Engineers, and other stakeholders.
  • Keep clients, executives, and external partners engaged throughout the project lifecycle to sustain involvement and satisfaction.

Edmund Optics is seeking a Senior Ecommerce Backend Engineer: AI-Native to build, integrate, and expand the backend services that power the companys evolving modular ecommerce platform. The role will design and develop APIs, services, data flows, and integrations that allow these platforms to work together reliably at scale. Validate AI-generated output for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance rather than treating generated code as automatically production-ready.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Data Steward / Senior Data Steward - Quality Excellence to help drive data quality, governance, and operational excellence across our diverse content domains.
In this role, you will work horizontally across multiple content areas to establish consistent data quality standards, strengthen governance practices, identify systemic issues, and drive scalable improvements. You will partner closely with Content Operations, Product, Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure our datasets are accurate, complete, consistent, scalable, and fit for customer and AI use cases.
This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys solving complex data-quality problems, bringing structure to ambiguity, and turning insights into sustainable improvements.

  • Implement consistent metadata and taxonomy standards.
  • Build quality dashboards that provide meaningful visibility into dataset health and quality.
  • Drive recurring quality issues to root-cause resolution across multiple domains.

The ideal candidate should combine strong technical depth with business leadership, with experience managing complex software projects, cloud platforms, engineering teams, client-facing technology engagements, and enterprise-scale systems.

Technology Strategy & Leadership

  • Work closely with the Founder/CEO and leadership team on technology investments, product strategy, digital transformation, and organizational growth.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve business efficiency, service offerings, and competitive positioning.
  • Establish engineering standards, architecture principles, development methodologies, and technology governance.
  • Build a technology roadmap supporting scalability, security, reliability, and future business expansion.

Engineering & Software Delivery

  • Provide leadership across software engineering, architecture, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, QA, and related technology functions.
  • Oversee the architecture and delivery of web, mobile, cloud, SaaS, eCommerce, and enterprise applications.
  • Ensure projects are delivered with appropriate standards for quality, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Establish effective code review, testing, CI/CD, release management, and deployment practices.
  • Review critical technical designs and guide teams in resolving complex architecture and production challenges.
  • Drive modernization of legacy systems and adoption of appropriate modern technologies.

Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure

  • Define the company's cloud and infrastructure strategy across platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Oversee cloud architecture, Kubernetes/container environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and disaster recovery.
  • Establish high availability, backup, business continuity, and disaster recovery standards.
  • Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud expenditure while maintaining reliability and scalability.
  • Promote Infrastructure as Code and automation using technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

  • Establish and continuously improve the organization's cybersecurity framework.
  • Ensure appropriate controls for application security, infrastructure security, identity and access management, data protection, vulnerability management, and incident response.
  • Implement security practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Oversee technology risk assessments, security audits, penetration testing, backup policies, and disaster recovery exercises.
  • Support compliance with applicable security, privacy, and client requirements.

AI, Automation & Innovation

Role Overview :-
We are seeking an experienced AI Agentic Architect to lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions. This is a hands-on, player-coach role:you will split your time between architecting production-grade multi-agent systems and writing, reviewing, and setting the standard for the code and patterns your delivery teams build on. Candidates must be genuinely code-fluent from day one - able to build and debug agentic systems personally, not direct from a distance. The ideal candidate will bridge business strategy and technical execution by defining scalable AI architectures, establishing governance standards, and driving AI adoption across the organization and its clients.





Roles & Responsibilities:
Enterprise AI Architecture & Strategy
Define enterprise AI architecture and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
Design scalable and secure AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI solutions.
Design end-to-end AI solutions including RAG, AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Knowledge Bases, and AI Workflows.
Architect AI integration with enterprise applications, databases, and cloud platforms.
Lead technical design reviews and architecture governance activities.
Ensure scalability, reliability, observability, and maintainability of AI solutions.
Agentic System Design (Hands-On)
Design Agentic AI ecosystems using orchestration frameworks, personally prototyping and hardening reference implementations.
Agent core mechanics:architect agent orchestration covering planning, reasoning, memory management, context management, task decomposition, and autonomous decision-making.
Multi-agent orchestration:design multi-agent patterns such as multi-tier topologies (router domain specialist utility agents), ReAct / ReWOO, and state-machine-based coordination (e.g., LangGraph).
Tool-use & integration contracts:design tool/function-calling architectures and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration layers, enforcing clean, decoupled contracts between agents, MCP servers, and downstream APIs.
Agent interoperability:define agent-to-agent communication and delegation using open interoperability standards (e.g., A2A) so specialist agents built on different frameworks can discover and collaborate across accounts.
Architect AI copilots, autonomous agents, and workflow automation solutions.
Define LLM selection, evaluation, prompt strategy, and guardrails, including build/buy trade-offs across prompting, fine-tuning, and model adaptation for cost and accuracy.
Knowledge, Retrieval & Data Architecture
Implement enterprise knowledge management and semantic search capabilities.
Define data architecture, vector database strategy, and metadata management.
Advanced retrieval:architect retrieval strategies beyond baseline RAG - including Graph RAG, hybrid search, and knowledge-graph-grounded systems (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune, RDF/SPARQL) - for higher factual grounding.
Establish data governance, security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Evaluation, Observability & Reliability
Agentic evaluation:design evaluation pipelines that assess full agent trajectories - tool-choice correctness, argument validity, step count, grounding validation, hallucination detection, cost/latency, and policy compliance - not just final outputs.
Observability & tracing:define end-to-end tracing and runtime monitoring of agent decisions, tool calls, and outcomes, with continuous quality, cost, and success-rate metrics (e.g., OpenTelemetry, LangSmith / Langfuse, Datadog).
Reliability engineering:ensure resilience of agentic systems in production through deterministic state management, error handling, retries/idempotency, fallback and human-in-the-loop escalation, and budget/timeout controls.
Define mechanisms for model evaluation, risk management, explainability, and compliance.
Governance, Responsible AI & Cost
Establish Responsible AI principles and governance controls.
Agent lifecycle governance:define registration, configuration, versioning, deprecation, and runtime governance for agents, applying policy-as-code and identity-as-code across design-time and runtime.
Agentic cost governance (FinOps):design token-cost budgeting, blast-radius controls, and approval guardrails before autonomous actions with financial or operational impact.
Agent security:design defences specific to autonomous systems - prompt-injection mitigation, least-privilege tool-permission scoping, execution sandboxing, and input/output validation across the agent-tool boundary.
Ensure AI solutions meet security, legal, and regulatory requirements.
Leadership, Delivery & Reusable IP
Act as trusted advisor to clients and business leaders.
Lead architecture workshops and technical discussions.
Mentor AI engineers, solution architects, and development teams - leading by example on code quality and architectural standards.
Reusable solution IP:produce reference architectures, solution blueprints, integration guides, and sizing frameworks consumable by field delivery teams across concurrent client accounts.

Agentic frameworks:hands-on experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent, and agent design patterns (tool-calling, planning/reasoning, memory).
Hands-on experience with Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS AI/ML, or Google Vertex AI.
Strong understanding of Machine Learning, NLP, Vector Search, and Knowledge Retrieval.
Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud-native architectures.

Agent operations & security:familiarity with agent evaluation, observability/tracing, and guardrail tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, NeMo Guardrails), and with agent security concerns such as prompt injection and tool-permission scoping.
Knowledge of security architecture, identity management, and AI governance.

jobDescription:
Position Summary
Design, configure, operate and optimize Databricks and cloud platform capabilities for Commercial Pharma data workloads from Vizag. The role ensures secure, reliable, cost-effective and scalable platform operations across environments, access controls, CI/CD, monitoring, performance and platform automation.


Business / Program Context
The role is part of a Vizag-based delivery capability supporting Commercial Pharma datasets across global markets. The work may include platform operations, data engineering, data quality, reporting, AI enablement, release governance and stakeholder support for enterprise commercial data products. The role is not limited to Japan-specific datasets; Japan market familiarity may be useful but is not a mandatory baseline requirement for most positions.


Job Responsibilities
  • Manage Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, workflows, notebooks, repos and platform configurations.
  • Support Unity Catalog, access controls, credential management, workspace permissions and audit readiness.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion, release automation and platform deployment standards.
  • Monitor cluster performance, job failures, usage patterns, costs and capacity.
  • Support cloud storage, networking, secrets, identity integration and environment provisioning activities.
  • Create reusable platform templates, automation scripts, monitoring alerts and operational runbooks.
  • Partner with Data Engineers and QA teams to resolve environment, performance, deployment and access issues.
  • Work as part of a Vizag-based delivery team supporting Commercial Pharma datasets and global commercial data stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with business, technology, governance, quality and offshore/onshore delivery teams across time zones.
  • Follow Agile delivery, SDLC, documentation, release, validation, access-control and data-governance standards.
  • Contribute to knowledge management, reusable assets, SOPs, runbooks and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Maintain strong communication discipline, including status updates, risk identification, issue escalation and timely stakeholder follow-through.


Required Work Experience
  • 4-8 years of relevant experience aligned to the role and seniority level.
  • Prior experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare analytics, commercial data platforms or enterprise data programs.
  • Experience working in a global delivery model with structured governance, documentation, SLAs and stakeholder communication.
  • Ability to work from Vizag and collaborate effectively with India, global and client teams.


Technical / Functional Skills

The Engineering Lead oversees the daytoday technical execution of IP discovery, classification, access monitoring, and protection controls. Engineering & Platform Implementation

Data Discovery & Classification Execution

Data Sources & Access Monitoring

Operational Security & Incident Response

Engineering Leadership

Transformation Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions.

Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.
  • Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.
  • Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.
  • Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.
  • Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
  • Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
  • Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.
  • Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.
  • Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.

What We''re Looking For

  • 12 17 years total experience; 4 6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M $30M range.
  • Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

  • Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.
  • Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.
  • Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.
  • Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management.

Set yourself apart:

  • Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
  • Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
  • Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
  • Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
  • Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient


What s in it for you

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
  • Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everything from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine:

  • Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains
  • Polished technical communications
  • Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer
  • Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience
  • A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers

The TAMs primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time.

The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs.

This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB.

Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Cool things you'll do

MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB

As a Technical Account Manager, you'll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between

You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB

You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem

What you need

You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted

It's crucial for every candidate to check these boxes:

  • Communicator:
    • Foster open lines of communication amongst internal stakeholders; The TAM ensures all concerned parties, including in some cases the MongoDB executive team, are well informed about accounts within the TAMs portfolio (especially during critical or escalated situations)
    • Great communication and account leadership skills of external stakeholders, with a good organizational understanding of customers and ability to calibrate communication style based on the audience
    • The TAM must quickly understand and communicate about customer workloads, use cases, and resiliency criteria, including performance, availability, and scalability
  • Collaborator:
    • Ability to work independently as well as cross-functionally to ensure customer needs are being met
    • Genuine desire to help people, and to increase their confidence and good will
    • Ability to cultivate strong team partnerships: Understanding of when and how to seek help from team members, skill in choosing from potentially conflicting perspectives or approaches; ability to secure commitments and lead collaborative efforts
  • Problem Solver:
    • Comfort thinking on your feet, solving problems in real-time, and reducing pressure and anxiety through calm, authoritative technical leadership; ability to keep your cool and project command presence during escalated situations where tensions and anxiety may be high
    • Ability to design, communicate, and follow a structured approach to solving complex problems based loosely upon the scientific method
    • Experience analyzing and pursuing issues holistically in the enterprise; spanning multiple technologies, customer teams and silos
  • Technical Expert:
    • Experience building, maintaining, tuning, and troubleshooting sophisticated mission-critical production database systems
    • Familiarity with modern service architectures and the implications on development teams, their structures and the development lifecycle
    • Experience with the technologies and development patterns typical of a large-scale enterprise customer
    • Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
  • Builder:
    • Develop, document, and help implement techniques, tools and procedures for optimizing MongoDBs technical relationship with marquee customers
  • Product evangelism:
    • The TAM helps customers understand how the MongoDB developer data platform is well-suited to solve a wide variety of their problems


Bonus Points
  • Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
  • Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures
  • Microservices/Serverless architectures
  • CI/CD tools and approaches
  • Containerization, orchestration and management tools
  • Enterprise Identity platforms
  • Experience using or managing MongoDB
  • Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
  • Strong systems engineering and troubleshooting experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, virtualization, clustering


Success Measures
  • In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training
  • In 6 months, you will be confident working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
  • In 12 months, you will be directly and independently engaged in technical account management, ensuring customers are successful and happy with MongoDB and see our developer data platform as the de facto standard for new projects

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Phone Billing
jobDescription:
Job Summary

Were looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of Phone Billing, one of the most critical components of HighLevels communication platform. Phone Billing sits at the intersection of product usage, infrastructure, and revenue - it is responsible for accurately metering and monetising usage across LC Phone products, including voice, messages, phone numbers, and other communication services.

The scale and criticality of this system make billing correctness non-negotiable. Every communication event can have a financial implication, and a single billing error can impact revenue, customer trust, and financial reconciliation at the same time. The platform processes 100M+ events daily across 15+ services, with billing workflows that need to remain accurate and reliable despite retries, duplicate events, delayed events, provider inconsistencies, partial failures, and continuously evolving pricing models.

As a Staff Engineer, youll own the architecture, scalability, reliability, and technical strategy of the Phone Billing platform. Youll solve complex distributed-systems problems around usage metering, rating, charging, idempotency, reconciliation, credits, refunds, adjustments, provider cost tracking, and billing lifecycle management. Youll also drive the architectural evolution required to support significantly higher volumes without compromising financial accuracy or system performance.

A key part of the role will be building billing systems that are correct by design - ensuring that every billable event is accounted for exactly once from a business perspective, even when the underlying infrastructure operates with retries, at-least-once delivery, asynchronous processing, and failures. Youll establish robust reconciliation mechanisms between HighLevels internal usage data, provider-level usage, and customer invoices, with strong observability and auditability to quickly identify and resolve discrepancies.

Youll work closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, Finance, and other Staff Engineers to define pricing and billing architecture, while partnering across Phone, WhatsApp, CPaaS, and provider-integration teams. Youll influence technical decisions beyond a single team, establish engineering standards, identify systemic technical debt, and drive long-term improvements in reliability, cost efficiency, data architecture, and operational excellence.

The broader Phone Core ecosystem includes CPaaS platform services, Trust Compliance, and phone number provisioning, giving this role significant architectural influence across the communication platform. Your primary focus, however, will be making Phone Billing a highly scalable, financially accurate, resilient, observable, and extensible platform capable of supporting the next 10x growth of HighLevels communication business.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical health of Phone Billing - proactively identify architectural bottlenecks, correctness and reliability risks, and technical debt; define and drive the roadmap to improve billing accuracy, reconciliation, scalability, observability, and cost efficiency as the platform scales to 10x its current volume.
  • Drive 1-2 high-impact initiatives end-to-end - take ownership from problem definition and technical discovery through architecture, implementation, rollout, and measurement, ensuring the initiatives deliver measurable improvements to Phone Billing in areas such as accuracy, reliability, scalability, or cost efficiency.
  • Architect for massive scale: Own the high-level architecture and scaling decisions for core Phone platform components, including CPaaS abstractions, provider adapters, and shared messaging/voice APIs that support billions of monthly events.
  • Own Phone Billing end to end: usage metering, rating, reserve/commit lifecycle, idempotency, reconciliation, and audit trails for the Phone channels - with zero tolerance for double-charging or lost usage
  • Lead the evolution of Revenue Growth into a configuration-driven, rules-based platform that adapts to new regulatory and carrier requirements without invasive engineering change
  • Work hands-on with technologies like NestJS, Firestore, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Queuing Systems, Data Warehousing Systems and Service Mesh-based microservices
  • Drive high-concurrency innovation: Lead the design and execution of cross-cutting initiatives to improve reliability, latency, and throughput across time-sensitive APIs and workflows serving millions of businesses.
  • Drive observability and resilience by evolving our monitoring, alerting (Prometheus/Grafana), and incident response strategies - including the financial invariants that must be alerted on, not just the technical ones
  • Leverage LLMs and AI tools to write, refactor, test, and debug code efficiently - while implementing guardrails to reduce hallucination and boost reliability
  • Partner with product, infra, security, finance and legal teams to ensure data integrity, access control, and compliance across phone services
  • Develop EM I leaders and senior engineers, build leadership pipeline, succession planning and raise the hiring bar

title: Sr. Product Analyst - AI Products
tagsAndSkills: cloud data,mixpanel,operating system,ai,analytics tools,business analytics,llm,artificial intelligence
jobDescription:
Role Overview

HighLevel's AI portfolio spans more than a dozen products, from conversational and voice agents that handle customer interactions on a business's behalf to copilots that help operators run the business itself. These products are sold both as a bundled subscription and on a pay-per-use basis, across a base of more than a million sub-accounts.

As Senior Product Analyst for AI Products, you will own the measurement of that portfolio. You will run the recurring business review, maintain the metric definitions for each product, report performance against the operating plan, and analyse retention, adoption and the unit economics of AI usage. Your work will inform the AI roadmap and will feed into quarterly and board-level reviews.

The role is hands-on. You will write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, build the reporting layer in Superset, and take responsibility for whether a figure is correct before anyone acts on it. You will work directly with the VP of Product and with the product managers who own each AI product, and we will expect you to form a view on what the data means and to defend it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the recurring business review for the AI portfolio, from building the underlying analysis through to presenting the results to product leadership.
  • Define and document the metrics for each AI product, including activation, adoption, the north star metric and penetration, and keep those definitions consistent across every report.
  • Build and maintain the Superset datasets, charts and dashboards the AI team depends on, and audit the existing reporting for hardcoded filters, stale queries and definitions that have drifted.
  • Write SQL against ClickHouse and Snowflake, including against semi-structured JSON columns, to answer the questions our dashboards cannot.
  • Report each products performance against the annual operating plan and subsequent re-forecasts, and explain the variances in terms of what happened in the product.
  • Analyse retention, cohort behaviour and adoption funnels at the sub-account level, and establish where and why accounts stop using a product.
  • Build the unit economics of AI usage, converting token consumption into cost by model and reporting cost-to-revenue ratio and margin by product.
  • Report on AI product quality, covering version-over-version evaluation results, containment and escalation rates, and the sampling design behind those figures.
  • Reconcile figures that disagree between sources, and decide which source should be used to answer which question.
  • Specify instrumentation with product managers before a feature ships, analyse in-product behaviour in Pendo once it has, and size the opportunities and experiments that go into the roadmap.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • At least six years of experience in product or business analytics, including time spent working directly with product teams.
  • Strong SQL skills. You should be able to write multi-CTE queries, window functions and cohort logic without assistance, query semi-structured JSON in Snowflake, and move into Python or R for the work SQL cannot do.
  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse, ideally ClickHouse and Snowflake.
  • The ability to author in Superset or Tableau, including building datasets and dashboards, and to open an existing chart definition and work out what it actually measures.
  • Experience with a product analytics tool such as Pendo, Amplitude or Mixpanel, including defining events and tracking plans.
  • Experience owning a recurring metrics pack or business review that other people depended on.
  • Careful attention to data grain and time period. You should check whether a figure is measured at the account or sub-account level before using it, and recognise what an incomplete period does to a cohort table.
  • A good command of SaaS metrics, including MRR and ARR movements, expansion and contraction, churn, retention and ARPU.
  • Enough statistical grounding to size and read an experiment honestly, and to say when a result is too noisy to act on.
  • Clear written English. A large part of this job is explaining an analysis in a short piece of writing that a busy reader can act on.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience analysing an AI or LLM product, particularly token consumption, model cost and quality evaluation.
  • Familiarity with usage-based or hybrid pricing models and the reporting problems they create.
  • Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation layer.
  • A background in CRM, agency or SMB SaaS products.
  • Experience with subscription analytics tools such as ChartMogul.

title: Software Engineer 3, AI Framework Integrations
jobDescription:
Job Summary
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Software Engineers to be among its founding members.
The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.
This is a strong role for an engineer who wants to grow into the AI space with real ownership. You'll own well-scoped projects from design through release, work with fast-moving and sometimes unproven technologies, and get a clear view of how the ecosystem is evolving. Priorities shift as frameworks change and customer demand moves, so we're looking for engineers who are adaptable, ask good questions, and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and participating in developer communities as MongoDB.
You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, with senior engineers and your manager close at hand as you take on larger pieces of it.
MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
Position expectations
  • Build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
  • Own well-scoped projects end to end on weekly-to-quarterly timelines, taking responsibility for the scope, schedule, and quality of your own work and communicating progress and trade-offs clearly
  • Solve day-to-day technical problems with growing independence, using the team's established patterns and past practice to guide your decisions, and seeking guidance on non-standard problems
  • Contribute to exploratory work on new frameworks: help evaluate an integration's feasibility, build a first working version of the piece you own, and share what you learn with the team
  • Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, following the team's contribution practices and maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy through external maintainer review cycles
  • Work within and improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility checks, and release steps. Suggest improvements where you see repeated friction
  • Help keep the integrations you work on healthy: monitor for upstream breaking changes, handle upgrades, triage incoming issues, and follow through after release
  • Coordinate with adjacent teams, including DBX, when your work depends on driver, platform, or product capability, and escalate cross-team dependencies and risks early rather than working around them
  • Collaborate with product management, product design, and other partners to understand what users need from an integration and how your work connects to the team's objectives
  • Write clear documentation, give useful code reviews, share what you know with teammates, and follow through on your commitments
  • Develop specialized knowledge of the Python or TypeScript AI builder ecosystems frameworks, agent and retrieval patterns, vector search and bring interesting developments back to the team
Qualifications
  • 3+ years of experience building backend systems, libraries, or other developer-facing software, with solid proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript
  • Experience designing, writing, testing, and debugging software in a shared, long-lived code base, with an eye for the tests and documentation that make it maintainable
  • Track record of delivering scoped projects reliably and on time, with growing independence and good judgment about when to ask for help
  • Demonstrated ability to work on several projects at once and keep quality and commitments intact as priorities shift
  • Clear interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, or vector search
  • Solid verbal and written technical communication, including the ability to write things down clearly for teammates and partners you won't always overlap with in real time
  • Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest
  • Eager to learn, with a strong technical foundation and an interest in deepening it
Nice to Have
  • Open source contributions, especially any work that landed in a repository you don't own
  • Experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications, professionally or as side projects
  • Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated testing for libraries that support multiple versions or platforms
  • Experience working with databases; familiarity with MongoDB query patterns
  • Exposure to vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management
  • Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust
  • Experience with containerization tools (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and libraries
  • Familiarity with Jira and related tools
Success measures
  • In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, how our integrations are structured, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and how we build, test, and release. You'll have landed your first code contribution and know who to ask when you're blocked
  • In three months, you will be delivering scoped work on one or more integrations with growing independence, will have landed an upstream contribution, and will be comfortable running the team's testing and release process for your own changes
  • In six months, you will own a well-defined area or project end to end, deliver against quarterly objectives with limited oversight, and have made at least one concrete improvement to the quality or efficiency of how the team works
  • In twelve months, you will be a dependable owner of a piece of the portfolio, will have delivered multiple meaningful features or integrations, will be handling upstream and customer issues in your area with confidence, and will be helping teammates get up to speed on what you know best

ABOUT ACUITY PROFESSIONAL


Acuity Professional is a UK-based professional services group providing specialist advice and support to businesses, entrepreneurs, property owners and private clients across the United Kingdom. ROLE OVERVIEW


We are seeking a commercially minded growth leader capable of building a high-performing digital marketing department that generates authority, trust and qualified opportunities across multiple professional service lines.


The Development Manager for Digital marketing will be responsible for building, leading and scaling Acuity's inhouse marketing function. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on delivery. The successful candidate will be accountable for generating qualified opportunities for Acuity's UK business divisions whilst establishing the systems, processes and team required to support long-term growth.

  • Manage specialist suppliers and freelancers where required, based in India

title: Senior Technical Lead-Full-Stack AI Engineer.
jobDescription:
Position Overview


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Lead to take end-to-end technical ownership of product development and feature delivery.

This role sits between the client/product team and the engineering team. You will participate in client and stakeholder discussions, understand new product requirements and improvements, translate them into technical solutions, design the architecture, scope and estimate the implementation, guide developers through execution, audit development quality, and ensure successful production release.


You will lead a team of approximately 6 engineers across AI, full-stack development, and QA.


This is not purely a people-management role and not simply a senior developer position. We are looking for someone who can own the complete technical lifecycle:


Requirement Solution Design Architecture Scope Estimate Development Plan Implementation Oversight Code Review QA Release Production Validation



While developers will execute much of the implementation, the Technical Lead remains accountable for ensuring the work is properly planned, technically correct, delivered on time, and productionready.


You should remain technically hands-on and capable of reviewing, debugging, improving, and where necessary contributing to production code


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Key Responsibilities


1. Client & Product Requirement Ownership


Work directly with clients, product stakeholders, and leadership to understand:


  • New product features
  • Product improvements
  • Workflow changes
  • AI capabilities
  • Integrations
  • Performance requirements
  • Technical issues
  • Architecture changes

You will be expected to:


  • Understand both the business requirement and its technical implications.
  • Ask the right questions before development begins.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, edge cases, and risks.
  • Challenge unclear or technically unsuitable approaches.
  • Translate requirements into clear technical implementation plans.
  • Explain technical options and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

2. Architecture & Technical Solution Design


Own the technical design of significant features and product changes.


Responsibilities include:


  • Review existing architecture before proposing changes.
  • Design backend, frontend, database, AI, API, and integration architecture.
  • Define system and data flows.
  • Identify dependencies across existing components.
  • Select appropriate technologies and implementation patterns.
  • Consider scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Create technical specifications and architecture diagrams where required.
  • Ensure new development remains aligned with the long-term architecture of the product.
  • The Technical Lead should be able to simplify solutions where possible while recognising when stronger architecture is required.

3. Technical Scoping, Estimation & Planning


Before development starts, convert product requirements into an actionable engineering plan


This includes:

  • Break requirements into technical components and development tasks.
  • Define frontend, backend, database, API, AI, integration, infrastructure, and QA requirements.
  • Identify technical dependencies and risks.
  • Define technical assumptions and edge cases.
  • Estimate development effort and timelines.
  • Determine required skills and developer allocation.
  • Establish the implementation sequence.
  • Define acceptance and technical completion criteria.

Significant development should not begin without sufficient technical planning.


The Technical Lead is responsible for ensuring estimates are realistic and that potential delays or technical risks are identified early.


4. Development Leadership & Technical Audit

Guide the engineering team throughout implementation.


Responsibilities include:

  • Explain architecture and implementation approach to developers.
  • Assign work based on developer capability.
  • Resolve technical questions and blockers.
  • Monitor development progress against scope and timeline.
  • Ensure developers follow the agreed architecture.
  • Identify scope drift and architectural deviations early.
  • Review critical implementation decisions during development.
  • Mentor engineers and improve technical capability across the team.

The Technical Lead is also responsible for auditing development quality, including:


  • Code architecture and structure
  • API implementation
  • Database implementation
  • AI integration
  • Security
  • Error handling
  • Performance and scalability
  • Logging and monitoring
  • Maintainability and reusability
  • Test coverage
  • Technical debt

Code review in this role is not simply approving pull requests. You must determine whether the implementation itself is technically correct and appropriate.


5. Quality, Release & Production Ownership


Work closely with QA and DevOps to ensure every significant release is production-ready.


Responsibilities include:


  • Define important technical test scenarios and edge cases.
  • Review unit, integration, API, E2E, and AI workflow testing.
  • Evaluate regression risks.
  • Verify integration dependencies.
  • Review release readiness.
  • Review database migrations and configuration changes.
  • Identify deployment dependencies and rollback requirements.
  • Coordinate production deployment.
  • Validate critical functionality after release.
  • Monitor post-release behavior.
  • Lead technical investigation of significant production issues.

The Technical Lead remains accountable until the feature has been successfully validated in production


Our products increasingly use AI as a core part of the product architecture. The Technical Lead should

have hands-on experience delivering AI functionality in production.


Experience should include production use of one or more of:

  • Prompt and system-prompt engineering

  • AI output validation
  • API failure handling

  • Token and context optimization
  • Caching strategies
